text: You labeled every column in my chart backwards.
The packing list you made forgot my passport.
I asked for a birthday toast and you wrote a eulogy.
You told me my car needed premium gas. It doesn't.
Your study plan had me cramming the wrong chapter.
That password tip got my account locked.
You promised a ten-minute workout. My timer says forty.
I asked you to shorten it and you made it longer.
Your playlist for the party cleared the room.
You confused my two clients and I sent the wrong invoice.
Why does every answer you give start with a disclaimer?
You said the meeting was Tuesday. Everyone else was there Monday.
Your lesson plan put my students to sleep.
I specifically said no bullet points.
The name you suggested for my band is already taken by three bands.
You doubled every measurement in my bread recipe.
My landlord laughed at the complaint letter you drafted.
You told me I could skip that form. I got a late fee.
Your color scheme made my website unreadable.
That fun fact you gave my kid for school was false.
I asked for synonyms and you gave me antonyms.
You keep calling me by the wrong name.
The interview answers you suggested sounded rehearsed and fake.
Your gardening calendar had me planting in a frost.
Is there a setting that makes you less wordy?
You promised the formula would work. It returns an error.
My book club said your discussion questions were childish.
You rounded my tax numbers and now they don't match.
I asked for a gentle reminder email and you wrote a threat.

That's the fourth time you've ignored my word limit.

The speech you wrote ran twice as long as my slot.
I told you I'm vegetarian. You suggested steak.
Your map description sent me the wrong way on a one-way street.
The thank-you note you wrote sounded sarcastic.
You turned my two-line question into a lecture.
My manager asked who wrote the report, and I had to admit it was you.
Your sleep advice kept me up all night.
You gave me the population of the wrong city.
I said casual tone. That reads like a legal contract.
The puzzle you made had no solution.
You made my resume sound like a robot wrote it.
Your timeline put the moon landing in the wrong decade.
I asked a yes or no question. Just say yes or no.
You suggested a gift my sister already returned last year.
Your instructions for the router reset wiped my settings.
The flashcards you made had the answers on the wrong side.
You estimated my drive at one hour. It took three.
You said this paint would dry overnight. It's still wet.
I gave you the exact error message and you ignored it.
Your rewrite changed the meaning of my whole paragraph.
The trivia answers you gave lost us the quiz night.
You assumed I was a beginner. I'm not.
That conversion from Celsius was wrong, and my cake burned.
You recommended a hotel that had closed for renovations.
Your bedtime story gave my daughter nightmares.
You made my polite complaint sound passive-aggressive.
Every time I correct you, you make a new mistake.
